permissions: Google Calendar OAuth scope: calendar.events (the server's README lists calendar.events and calendar as options; TO VERIFY which one it requests at runtime)
riskNote: Creating an event with attendees can send a calendar invite to a customer, so booking is customer-facing. The server supports limiting tools with --enable-tools or ENABLED_TOOLS: expose only list-events, get-event, search-events, get-freebusy, get-current-time and create-event, so update-event and delete-event are not available. manage-accounts is always available regardless of the filter. The README says credentials stay on the local machine and mentions no telemetry. Maintained: latest release v2.8.1 (October 2026, 1,200+ stars).
